BFA.note: The minister speaks of mastering AI risks; no rule or authority is stated.
Only an ambition and a ministry AI roadmap being finalised; the AI convention is for weather forecasting, a sector.

facts.fact: Burkina Faso's digital transition minister and the director general of the national meteorological agency ANAM signed a collaboration and research convention on 10 October 2025 to bring AI into forecasting, with ANAM saying it was chosen as the pilot structure.

BFA.note: Document names no AI model, dataset or computing built or hosted in the country.
Document mentions AI for forecasts but no satellite data.
Document names the national police only as a planned AI convention partner, with no station records.
